 Thwarting the thief of time


 Tim Cross

Senior science writer


 I usually write these newsletters on a Thursday afternoon. But this week I was editing the Science section, to cover for a colleague who was away. That took me until after 10pm on Wednesday. The following day I was tired and still a bit cross-eyed from all the close proofreading, so I ended up putting the job off. Now I have to write it just as the deadline is looming.


 Procrastination, as the saying goes, is the thief of time. It’s also the subject of

76842.subject: 🐶📰 Weekend Update
76842.body:
**BTC** $63,042 (-1.4%) | **ETH** $1,866 (-1.2%) | **SOL** $73 (-1.0%)

———————————————————————————

Welcome to the Daily Bone Weekend Update where we recap the top stories from the  week. Be sure to check out our daily newsletter to get all of your news hot off the press each and every weekday!

———————————————————————————

### Headlines

* [Leopold Aschenbrenner capitulated](https://x.com/Barchart/status/2082866042771050894) and sold his stock holdings to Citadel — Chip stocks sank early in the week before rebounding

* The Fed held rates steady in a divided [9-3 vote](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2082526632506450097)

* Russia's FSB [charged](https://www.reuters.com/world/russias-fsb-charges-telegram-founder-durov-with-facilitating-terrorism-ifax-says-2026-07-29/) Telegram founder Pavel Durov with "facilitating terrorism"

* Cold Card BTC wallets [got exploited](https://x.com/0xQuit/status/2083042420477055377?s=20) for over 500 BTC due to a weak entropy algorithm

* Bitcoin fell back [below $83k](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2083204912666534125?s=20) after failed breakout

———————————————————————————

### TradFi

* Vlad Tenev added X safeguards after [being hacked](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2082127606275576233)

* SPCX hit a [new all-time low of $110](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2081741648459874510)

* South Korean finance minister held [emergency meeting](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2082383791264305285?s=20) after KOSPI volatility — Decided to cap retail exposure to [leveraged ETF investment](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2082442445921374637)

* Strategy reports [$8.2B Q2 losses](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2082929512048931221?s=20)

———————————————————————————

### Crypto

* Treasury Secretary invoked [Satoshi Nakamoto](https://decrypt.co/374758/treasury-secretary-bitcoin-satoshi-nakamoto-clarity-act) in plea for the CLARITY Act — SEC vowed to [set crypto rules](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2082849081529933850) if Congress stalls on CLARITY

* Morgan Stanley launched a[ Solana ETP](https://x.com/tokens/status/2082425913384521948?s=20)

* [Stonk Broker NFTs](https://x.com/Tyler_Did_It/status/2082788561942679779?s=20) on Robinhood came close to flipping Pudgy Penguins

* Tether posted [$1.5B](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2083210789494706255?s=20) in Q2 operating profits

* Zcash activated ["Ironwood"](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2082111170626851180), launching a formally verified new shielded pool with turnstile supply checks

———————————————————————————

### AI

* OpenAI slashes GPT-5.6 Luna prices [80%](https://x.com/tradfi/status/2082874001886691609), trims GPT-5.6 Terra prices 20% to [$2 per million](https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2082919018407628896) tokens

* Chinese military researchers distill OpenAI and Anthropic models to train [domestic AI systems](https://x.com/Barchart/status/2082866042771050894) for defense
